commits.subject: reel (SMB-AUDIO-CODECS slice 1): FLAC decode + encode (RFC 9639), audio codec descriptors, opt-in audio file providers
reel (SMB-AUDIO-CODECS slice 2): Ogg reader + Vorbis (lewton) + Opus (opus-pure) + Ogg FLAC decode
reel (SMB-AUDIO-CODECS slice 3): MPEG audio Layers I-III decode (safe-Rust minimp3 port) + mpeg-audio provider
reel (SMB-AUDIO-CODECS slice 4): Studio-owned AAC-LC decoder (ISO/IEC 14496-3) + aac-adts provider

capabilities_done: FLAC decoder (src/audio/flac.rs, Studio-owned, written from RFC 9639): STREAMINFO, frame header + CRC-8, CONSTANT/VERBATIM/FIXED/LPC subframes, wasted bits, 4/5-bit Rice with escapes, left/side, side/right, mid/side, 33-bit side channel of 32-bit streams, frame CRC-16, STREAMINFO MD5 re-computed; bit-exact against libavcodec on two ffmpeg-written files (16-bit stereo LPC, 24-bit mono) and MD5 verified

FLAC encoder: FIXED orders 0-4, partitioned Rice (orders 0-8, per-partition parameter), stereo decorrelation choice, 4-24 bit, 1-8 channels; encode_flac writes full STREAMINFO (MD5, frame sizes); provider encode_segment (WAV byte layout in) writes STREAMINFO first with total samples and MD5/frame sizes unknown (RFC 9639 allows zero)

decoded-audio delivery loop (src/audio/engine.rs): interleaved f32le AudioSamples chunks bounded by max_chunk_bytes, exact-or-fail export, out-of-range before payload read, receipts from the loop cursor; decode_audio_file (whole file, max_frames budget, planar() for Score)

descriptors: audio_codec_descriptors / Registry::audio_codec_descriptors (decoder id, version, licence, certification); standalone audio providers opt-in via Registry::register_audio_codecs / with_audio_codecs (standard() unchanged so the reel provider-list tests stay as judged)

Ogg (src/audio/ogg.rs, Studio-owned from RFC 3533): page CRC (0x04C11DB7, not the D16 ZIP CRC), lacing reassembly with the packet budget checked while a packet grows, lost-continuation detection, first Vorbis/Opus/FLAC stream selected by its BOS packet, presented length from the last page granule (bounded tail scan); provider ogg-audio (opt-in); unknown Ogg codecs (theora, speex) are MEDIA_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE naming them

Vorbis (src/audio/vorbis.rs) via lewton 0.10.2: ident header bounds (channels <= 8, rate <= 768 kHz) checked by reel, setup header codebook pre-scan (Vorbis I 3.2.1; entries + lookup values budget 2^20) before lewton allocates, comment header never parsed (lewton allocates its u32 lengths unchecked); within 0.5/32768 of libavcodec over 10897 frames; 11025 frames = last granule

Opus (src/audio/opus.rs) via opus-pure 0.2.2: OpusHead and ISO BMFF dOps parsing by reel, output gain (RFC 7845 5.1), pre-skip + granule end trim, own RFC 6716 Appendix B self-delimited multistream splitter over per-stream decoders honouring the header mapping table; within 0.5/32768 of libopus (stereo, 5.1); 5.1 delivered in the stream's Vorbis order
Ogg FLAC mapping on the slice-1 FLAC decoder: bit-exact against libavcodec
third-party decoder calls behind catch_unwind (src/audio/packet.rs guarded): a panic is MEDIA_DECODER_FAULT decoder_crashed and poisons the decoder

MPEG audio (src/audio/mp3.rs, mp3_dsp.rs, mp3_tables.rs): Studio-owned safe-Rust port of minimp3 (CC0-1.0, NOTICE): MPEG-1/2/2.5 Layers I, II, III, free format, bit reservoir (511 B), MS / intensity stereo, short and mixed blocks; bitstream arithmetic checked (deny arithmetic_side_effects), DSP stages over fixed buffers (allow, justified in the file header); corrupt gains bounded to finite output within MP3_OUTPUT_BOUND 8.0

provider mpeg-audio (src/audio/mp3_stream.rs): ID3v2 tags skipped against max_probe_bytes, sync confirmed by successor headers, Xing/Info frame skipped, LAME gapless trim (delay + 529, padding) as libavformat does, header walk total when no Xing count, trailing tags end the stream; measured within 0.5 LSB (Layer III CBR stereo, MPEG-2 LSF mono VBR with short blocks) and 1.0 LSB (Layer II) of libavcodec, exact gapless lengths
provider.rs: one open_stream dispatcher (kind -> FrameSource) used by probe, decode_segment and decode_audio_file

AAC-LC (src/audio/aac_lc.rs, aac_dsp.rs, Studio-owned from ISO/IEC 14496-3): SCE/CPE/LFE for channel configurations 1-7, section data, Huffman scale factors (intensity positions, PNS energies) and spectra 1-11 with escapes, pulse, TNS after the stereo tools, M/S, intensity stereo (INTENSITY_HCB +1 / HCB2 -1, inverted by ms_used only for ms_mask_present 1), PNS (LCG noise, shared under M/S), IMDCT via DCT-IV / N/4 FFT (unit-tested against the defining sum), sine/KBD windows, ONLY_LONG / LONG_START / EIGHT_SHORT / LONG_STOP; HE-AAC signalling, 960 frames, PCE, CCE, explicit rates typed refusals; measured within 0.5/32768 of libavcodec on stereo (M/S + IS), mono (short windows) and 5.1

provider aac-adts (src/audio/aac.rs): ADTS headers bounded (13-bit frame length, single raw data block), AudioSpecificConfig built and checked before a decoder exists, header-walk total; esds parser for the ISO BMFF hook

DecodedAudio::planar() gives Score's planar f32 layout.
notes.registry_choice: Audio providers are NOT added to Registry::standard(): tests/foundation_contract.rs (registry list == 4 ids) and tests/engine_video.rs (every registered provider needs an export case) belong to judged reel lanes; adding them to standard() needs those tests updated by their lanes (lead decision). Opt-in like MxfProvider.
notes.licensing: slice 1 deps: none (FLAC + MD5 Studio-owned). Slice 2: lewton 0.10.2 (MIT OR Apache-2.0, Vorbis), opus-pure 0.2.2 (BSD-3-Clause, Opus; unsafe only in runtime-dispatched SIMD kernels with scalar fallbacks). opus-decoder 0.1.1 (MIT OR Apache-2.0) was tried first and REJECTED on evidence: its multistream splitter reads the self-delimited length before the TOC (RFC 6716 Appendix B puts it after) and it panicked in debug builds on a libopus 5.1 file (celt/vq.rs:118 `1u8 << i` shift overflow; release would wrap silently). Planned: soundkit-aac-lc 0.12.3 (MIT, AAC-LC; pulls rustfft 6.4.1 MIT OR Apache-2.0), MP3 decoder adapted into reel from minimp3 (CC0-1.0) in safe Rust. Rejected: symphonia (MPL-2.0, never read), nanomp3 (c2rust of minimp3, 41 unsafe sites on hostile input), puremp3 (no accuracy claims, reader-based, old bitstream-io), moosicbox_opus_native (MPL-2.0). OPERATOR ITEM (STU-VID-084): AAC and MP3 decode ship list is a licensing decision; MP3 patents expired, AAC patent pool status UNVERIFIED.
